# One docblock tag per line: the tag name and its payload, as written after the gutter.
# Pins where `steins-phpdoc`'s tag scanners split the type from the variable (issue #932).
@var Foo the result, unlike $other
@var int counts rows; see $total
@var Foo $x the result
@var Foo|null $y
@var Foo
@var Foo some description
@var array<int, string> $items the items
@var $x Foo
@var Foo $this
@var Foo $this->prop
@var int|string $v, $w
@var callable(int $a): void $cb
@var Foo|Bar the thing called $x
@var ?int the id $x
@param int $n the count
@param int the count $n
@param int ...$rest
@param int &$ref
@param int &...$both
@param int & ... $spaced
@param int the count of $items
@param callable(int $a): void $cb
@param callable(int $a): void the callback $cb
@param array{a: int} $shape description
@param $x Foo
@param $x
@param int
@param int the count, see $n
@param Foo|null the value $n description with $other
@phpstan-param int the count $n
@phpstan-assert Foo $x
@phpstan-assert Foo the value $x
@phpstan-assert !Foo $x
@property Foo $bar
@property Foo $bar the thing
@property Foo the thing $bar
@property-read int the count, unlike $other
@property-write Foo|null $bar description
